title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: What timeouts are for
hook: What is the first thing you say in a timeout?
intro: The other team just scored four runs.
You call time and walk out to the circle.
statement: A timeout can calm a team or teach one. Rarely both.
q1: Do you use timeouts to calm and reset —
q2: or to teach a specific fix?
q3: What did the team need just then?
t1: Every game is different. But timeouts work
t2: when they have one clear purpose.
cta: Coaches — what are your timeouts for?
ctaLines: Breathe. Get one out. One change.
ctaPrompt: Share your timeout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What is the first thing you say in a timeout?
The other team just scored four runs. You call time and walk out to the circle.
A timeout can calm a team or teach one. Rarely both.
Reset or teach. Every team is different.
What are your timeouts for? Share your habit in the comments.
